name: Ghost Slayers
body:
The first bloodstalker order to exist was the Ghost Slayers, who originated as an order of fallen paladins hell-bent on continuing their crusade with or without the backing of their gods. They are credited with the discovery of the stalker’s draught and the sanguine ritual that the bloodstalkers still rely on to this day.

Blessed are the Living (Su)

At 3rd level, the bloodstalker can smite undead. This functions as the paladin’s smite evil ability, except it can only target creatures that are undead or that are controlling undead. He can use this ability once per day at 3rd level, plus one additional time each day at 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th level.

Hallowed Mercy (Su)

At 7th level, after performing his sanguine ritual, the bloodstalker gains the ability grant mercy to a creature he touches a number of times per day equal to half his bloodstalker level + his Wisdom modifier. This otherwise functions as the paladin’s mercy ability.

Blessed are the Good (Su)

Beginning at 11th level, the bloodstalker can smite any evil creature.

The Eyes of Truth (Su)

At 15th level, the bloodstalker can spend one use of his mercy to cast true seeing on himself. His caster level with this effect is equal to his bloodstalker level.

Vengeful Spirit (Su)

At 19th level, when the bloodstalker’s hit point total is below 0, but he is not dead, he becomes incorporeal until his hit points are brought back above 0 and may choose to act normally on his turn. He must still make a Constitution check each round to avoid losing additional hit points. The bloodstalker must make this decision as soon as he is reduced to negative hit points (even if it isn’t his turn). If he does not choose to act normally, he immediately falls unconscious. the bloodstalker can use this ability once per day. When using vengeful spirit, if the bloodstalker’s negative hit points are equal to or greater than his Constitution score, he immediately dies.
